name: Razzeric's Tweaking
summary: On the Shimmering Flats, Razzeric's Tweaking gives racers more power once Pozzik is done with them. A seaforium booster ordered from Shreev in Gadgetzan traveled by zeppelin, which Razzeric says crashed in Dustwallow Marsh. He wants the booster brought back.

sections.title: More Juice
sections.body: Pozzik is a fine mechanic, Razzeric says, but too cautious with firepower and too ready to hold back. Once Pozzik finishes with a racer, Razzeric loosens its controls, removes parts of its frame, and adds power. He ordered a seaforium booster from Shreev at the Gizmorium in Gadgetzan. Razzeric says the zeppelin carrying it crashed in Dustwallow Marsh. The booster belongs back on the Shimmering Flats. Facing the track without that extra kick would be a travesty.

sections.title: Strapped to the Racer
sections.body: Razzeric praises the booster, which holds a full fifteen pounds of seaforium. Strapped to a racer's side, it should carry him through the circuit fast enough to beat the gnomes twice over.

faq.answer: Razzeric races on the Shimmering Flats and changes racers himself after Pozzik finishes with them.

faq.q: Where did the booster come from?
faq.answer: Razzeric ordered the booster from Shreev at the Gizmorium in Gadgetzan.

faq.q: Where is the seaforium booster now?
faq.answer: Razzeric says the zeppelin carrying the booster crashed in Dustwallow Marsh.

faq.q: Why does Razzeric want the booster?
faq.answer: Razzeric wants more power than Pozzik is willing to load, and thinks facing the track without that extra kick would be a travesty.
